mentions.name: Mythos
mentions.description: An AI-native book reader that understands what you're reading. Highlighting text triggers inferred intent with inline contextual actions, such as auto-suggested questions for confusing paragraphs, spoiler-free character context for names, and concise argument breakdowns with assumptions and counterpoints. Works across EPUBs, PDFs, and papers, with a design principle that AI should be assistive, never intrusive—no prompts required and no context switching.
mentions.problem: The author reads a lot of dense material and hated breaking flow while reading; this reader keeps assistance inline without prompts or context switching.
